rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer) names the item. Parts III and V and Schedule 1 print every amount in one comb per column with no centavo comb ('DO NOT enter Centavos'), so amounts come from derived:amount_* keys of to_print_field_map: whole pesos (49 centavos or less drop down, 50 or more round up), digits only, right-aligned in the comb; an overpayment prints in parentheses; a zero amount, column B of a non-joint return, and an amount wider than the comb stay blank. The sheet numbers Part III Item 31 Surcharge and 32 Interest (the page's own controls are the other way round), so those derived amounts follow the printed captions. The address splits over the item 8 combs (40 + 32 slots) at a word break; the date of birth, the page 2 TIN (nine fillable slots), each employer's 14-digit TIN, Item 37's two digits and the spouse RDO (blank unless joint) are derived: keys too. Never submitted. Schedule 1 Item 4 prints what the return files: OTHERS with the add-more popup subtotal when more than four employers are filed; the popup rows themselves have no cells. Since #113 the Items 6, 20, 24 and Schedule 1 mark cells hold two boxes under one input name, so their xbox_joins name each box by its input id (<cell>-i0/-i1), and the Items 45/49/51/57 (specify) inputs, inset past the caption, print the descriptions. Left blank on print: the Items 4 and 18 TIN branch combs (the frozen sheet has no inputs in them), Item 3 ATC (II011 is preprinted), the signature block and Part IV payment details (Items 38-41, no writer values). The submitted XML always carries every value. Booleans fill X in the box left of the printed option. Every value the print map carries has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason.
